name: The Use of Colours in Art

exhibition_i18n.heading: Ohne Farbe wäre ein Künstler nicht in der Lage, sein Motiv genau darzustellen und zu beschreiben. Künstler, insbesondere Maler und Handwerker, verwandeln ihr Wissen über Farben in lebendige Darstellungen von Stimmung, Ausdruck, Licht und Tiefe.
exhibition_i18n.subtitle: Über Techniken, Symbolik und Bedeutungen

exhibition_i18n.heading:
***This is the demo exhibition for the new MWNF online exhibition platform.***  
  
Without colour an artist would be unable to accurately depict and describe their subject. Artists, especially painters and craftspeople, transform their knowledge of colour into vivid representations of mood, expression, light, and depth. Such aspects are crucial as they ultimately affect how the viewer interprets a piece.
exhibition_i18n.subtitle: About Techniques, Symbolism and Meanings
